author: adramelekh.
content:
How to launch on vibe/vibe testnet:

1. Set up a supported wallet.
2. Get Robinhood Chain testnet funds from <#1541738768468414484>.
3. Go to https://testnet.vibevibe.fun
4. Create your project/token and bonding curve.
5. Choose the right category when available.
6. Make sure your project meets the minimum requirement:
   - Meme/artcoin: culture effort and public social presence.
   - RWA: working testnet functionality or simulation.
   - Vibecoded/product: MVP, demo, prototype, or usable flow.
7. Share your launched project in <#1544666579898339328>.

If you run into launch problems, ask in <#1544666860744744990>.
